name: generic-tutor
description: A generic academic tutor: canonical course content, per-learner progress tracking, spaced-repetition review, enrollment gating (level-lock/roster-cap/phase-convergence), a diagnostic adaptive-teaching layer with per-item BKT mastery and rubric-criterion tagging, a blocking post-compile structural gate, and an optional read-only client-side toolkit (GUI + CLI) for backup, health, and progress checks without opening a session.
